page_title: BHA 1-1 SOU | Brighton v Southampton 29/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+14' That's the end of the match.
90+13' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
90+12' Tyler Dibling (Southampton) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
90+12' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Southampton) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
90+10' The corner from Yasin Ayari (Brighton) is intercepted by the defence.
90+10' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) is thwarted and cleared to safety. The ball goes out of play. Brighton are awarded a corner kick.
90+9' Jan Paul van Hecke (Brighton) has a sight of goal and shoots from distance, but Joe Lumley is equal to it.
90+8' Mats Wieffer (Brighton) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
90+6' Brighton keep possession of the ball by producing one-two passes, but an opponent steps in and wins the ball.
90+2' Joe Lumley makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded by Simon Adingra (Brighton) after a cross from the side.
90+2' It will be a substitution. Ben Brereton Diaz (Southampton) is ready to enter the pitch as Adam Armstrong walks off.
90+1' Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Southampton.
90' The fourth official shows 10 min. of added time.
88' Russell Martin has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Kamaldeen Sulemana (Southampton) replacing Cameron Archer.
88' Substitution. Georginio Rutter walks off the pitch and Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) comes on as a substitute.

88' Ambitious effort from Yasin Ayari (Brighton). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Southampton will have a goal kick.
85' Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Southampton.
83' Ryan Manning (Southampton) quickly takes the free kick with a short pass.
82' Mats Wieffer (Brighton) makes a rough challenge and Robert Jones blows his whistle for a foul. Southampton are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.

80' Bart Verbruggen makes a brilliant save! Tyler Dibling (Southampton) easily weaves through the defence and fires the ball from mid-range. His effort goes towards the bottom right corner but is saved by the keeper!
79' Here's the change. Danny Welbeck leaves the pitch and Evan Ferguson (Brighton) comes on as a substitute.
78' Southampton seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
76' Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.

75' Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat. Brighton force their opponents to concede a corner.
74' Yasin Ayari (Brighton) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

73' Georginio Rutter (Brighton) connects with a precise cross inside the goalmouth and shoots. One of the defending players reacts in time and clears the ball to safety. The ball goes out of play and Brighton have been awarded a corner kick.
72' Fabian Hurzeler decides to make a substitution. Joao Pedro will be replaced by Simon Adingra (Brighton).
72' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Tariq Lamptey as he is replaced by Lewis Dunk (Brighton).
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Matt O'Riley trots off the pitch and is replaced by Mats Wieffer (Brighton).
72' Celebrations are cut short for Southampton as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
68' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Southampton players aren’t happy.
67' Goal! Ryan Fraser provides Cameron Archer (Southampton) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort inside the right post. 1:2.
66' Russell Martin prepares a substitution. Flynn Downes is replaced by Joe Aribo (Southampton).
66' The substitution has been made. Ryan Fraser (Southampton) has replaced Yukinari Sugawara.
63' The corner kick from Yasin Ayari (Brighton) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
62' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) controls the ball from the resulting free kick inside the six-yard box, but his effort is blocked by one of the defending players. Brighton will take a corner kick.
62' It seemed like Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
61' Russell Martin is stunned as referee Robert Jones shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
61' Robert Jones has a clear sight and sees a foul from Flynn Downes (Southampton). A free kick has been awarded to Brighton.
59' 1 - 1 Goal! Flynn Downes (Southampton) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the right side of the goal. It's 1:1.
56' Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
55' Taylor Harwood-Bellis (Southampton) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
53' Mateus Fernandes (Southampton) swings the ball into the box from the corner kick but it's a bit too strong and it goes out of play.
52' Joao Pedro (Brighton) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball goes out of play and Southampton will have a goal kick.
52' The corner from Matt O'Riley (Brighton) is cleared away by the defence.
51' Georginio Rutter (Brighton) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players. Now Brighton have a corner.
50' Matt O'Riley (Brighton) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Southampton.
49' Yasin Ayari (Brighton) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Robert Jones blows his whistle for a foul.
48' Adam Armstrong (Southampton) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball is out of play. Brighton will take a throw-in.
47' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. The ball goes out of play and Southampton will have a goal kick.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+4' Matt O'Riley (Brighton) sends in a cross from the free kick which goes out of play.

45+3' Joao Pedro (Brighton) accelerated away from the defence and took his shot early from the edge of the box. The ball flew towards the bottom left corner, but Joe Lumley made a superb athletic save to deny him.
45+2' Adam Armstrong (Southampton) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Robert Jones no option but to blow his whistle.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.

44' What a big chance! Cameron Archer (Southampton) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball just over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brighton.
43' The resulting corner from Mateus Fernandes (Southampton) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
43' Ryan Manning (Southampton) latches on to a cross on the edge of the box and fires a shot at goal, but his effort was blocked by one of the defenders. Southampton get a corner.
43' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) tries to find Joao Pedro with a clever through ball from the corner of the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
40' Matt O'Riley (Brighton) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.

40' Georginio Rutter (Brighton) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger. Brighton have been awarded a corner kick.
39' Mateus Fernandes (Southampton) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
37' Ryan Manning (Southampton) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.
37' Cameron Archer (Southampton) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Southampton.
35' The ball is cleared after Danny Welbeck (Brighton) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
31' Referee Robert Jones halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Fabian Hurzeler, then shows him a yellow.
31' Kyle Walker-Peters (Southampton) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
31' Kyle Walker-Peters (Southampton) is penalised for holding. Robert Jones signals a set piece. Brighton get a free kick.
29' 1 - 0 Goooooal! Tariq Lamptey beats his man and slings in a cross towards Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton), who evades his marker and plants a fine header inside the left post from close in. 1:0.

28' Ryan Manning (Southampton) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
26' Mateus Fernandes (Southampton) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
26' Adam Armstrong (Southampton) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.

25' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) blows a huge opportunity! He latches on to a perfect cross from the wing into the penalty area, but sends a bullet header just wide of the left post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Southampton.
23' Cameron Archer (Southampton) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.

20' Mateus Fernandes (Southampton) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
18' The corner is swung in but Southampton can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

18' Cameron Archer (Southampton) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The referee blows his whistle, Southampton are awarded a corner kick.
16' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Matt O'Riley (Brighton) was quite harsh and Robert Jones didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

16' OFF THE POST! Georginio Rutter (Brighton) runs towards the goal to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from the edge of the box, but it crashes against the left post. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky. The ball goes out of play and Southampton will have a goal kick.
15' Brighton are happy showing off their ball keeping skills and that is only interrupted when the defender steps in.
12' Robert Jones shows a yellow card to Flynn Downes (Southampton) for his blatant foul.
11' Ryan Manning (Southampton) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.

9' Great solo effort from Georginio Rutter (Brighton)! He beat a couple of players and shot from the edge of the box, but the effort slips just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Southampton.
8' Tyler Dibling (Southampton) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.

7' That was close by Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Southampton.
6' Southampton can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

6' Adam Armstrong (Southampton) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Southampton will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
5' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) did his best to latch onto a through ball, but it was too strong. The ball goes out of play and Southampton will have a goal kick.
4' Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
3' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Tyler Dibling (Southampton).
1' Southampton are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Southampton will kick the game off.
Robert Jones will referee today's match.
